summary: Gold X2 Mining Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on NYSE American, TSXV and FWB, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 14, 2026, announcing its inclusion in the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ) following the ETF's semi-annual review and rebalancing announced September 11, 2026, effective at market close on September 18, 2026. No stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or transaction mechanics are stated; the disclosure is an index-inclusion liquidity event tied to the Moss Gold Project, not a special situation. Watch passive-flow demand and post-rebalance volume around the September 18 effective date.
